title: An entry with no part behind it can be edited and a new part links to it
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Part Library entry {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ORPHAN-01) has no inventory part behind it ("Total parts" 0).
  • The entry's new description is {Description-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL orphan entry edited").
  • The description you will type for the new part is {Description-B} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL orphan link").
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  2. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the {Part-A} row.
  4. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  5. Replace the Description with {Description-A}.
  6. Click Save.
  7. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  8. Click New Inventory Part.
  9. Type {Description-B} in Description.
  10. Type {Part-A} in Part Number, exactly as the entry has it.
  11. Pick any Category.
  12. Type 10.00 in Cost.
  13. Type 20.00 in Sell Price.
  14. Click Save.
  15. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  16. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  17. Click the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: The entry with nothing behind it can be edited: the detail page shows {Description-A}.
  • Step 14: The part is saved and linked to that entry: a green toast reads "Part created. Linked to {Part-A} in the Part Library. Its description "{Description-A}" was kept."
  • Step 16: Still one entry {Part-A}: no second entry was created.
  • Step 17: The detail page keeps the description {Description-A} and now shows "Total parts" 1.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S11-E2, S7-R5, S7-R6, S7-R9, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.4 (Saved and linked to the Part Library entry), board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), 13 Oct copy. QA lead's 9 Oct set-up answer 4 (a deleted inventory part keeps its Part Library entry). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-E2: “An entry with no inventory part behind it can still be edited from its detail page, and is the entry a new part links to when its number is typed exactly (S7-R5).”
  • S7-R5: “If exactly one entry matches, the new part is linked to that entry.”
  • S7-R6: “A linked entry keeps its own description. The description typed in the dialog does not change it.”
  • S7-R9: “When the part was linked to an existing entry whose description differs from the one typed, ignoring upper and lower case and spaces before and after, the system shows "Part created. Linked to {part number} in the Part Library. Its description "{library description}" was kept." For example: "Part created. Linked to N68SL-356 in the Part Library. Its description "BRAKE PAD" was kept."”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (New part linked to an entry whose description differs): “"Part created. Linked to {part number} in the Part Library. Its description "{library description}" was kept." | Success toast, fades on its own”
